Test a DBA combination to see if a more sophisticated iterative approach improves over weighted inverse_error, given the unstable ranking and correlated errors.
ranking is unstable and several models have correlated errors; test a softmax_neg_error weighted combo on the full pool to see if it captures complementary strengths.
The series has high trend and seasonality but ranking is unstable; a robust, non‑parametric aggregator like median may capture diverse model behavior.
The series has high trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a trimmed mean may reduce outlier influence from weak models while keeping more diversity.
Outlier pct high and ranking unstable; try a per‑horizon top‑k mean to capture changing best models across horizons.
The series has high outliers and unstable ranking; a weighted softmax over a tighter pool may reduce noise.
The series has high outliers and unstable ranking; a per‑model weighting that favours lower‑error models may help.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8632. Series context: trend strength 0.8259 and seasonal strength 0.723; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.236); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 6.067.
